threads.label: US naval blockade and Iran's oil exports
threads.summary: CENTCOM said USS New Orleans was sailing in the Arabian Sea during the US blockade of Iranian ports, with 48 vessels redirected over 20 days. Bloomberg reported Iran is curbing oil output as exports plunge and storage fills, while Iran International reported inflation above 73% and concerns over internal instability.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and diplomatic contacts
threads.summary: Iran International reported Tehran is framing the Strait of Hormuz as non-negotiable, while IRIB said Foreign Minister Araghchi spoke by phone with counterparts in Italy and Qatar on regional developments and Islamabad mediation. Defa Press claimed a former Trump-era State Department official, Nick Stewart, has joined the US negotiating team with Iran.

threads.label: Executions and asset seizures inside Iran
threads.summary: Iran International reported two men were hanged after the Supreme Court upheld death sentences for spying for Israel, which IRIB identified as Yaqoub Karimpour and Naser Bakrzadeh. Defa Press said Tehran's prosecutor had seized assets of more than 250 individuals linked to counter-revolution networks, including 63 items from Iran International's director.

threads.label: Lebanon strikes and regional resistance claims
threads.summary: Defa Press reported continuing Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon, citing Lebanese figures of 2,659 killed and 8,183 wounded, and posted a Hezbollah claim of downing an Israeli Heron 450 drone. IRIB carried a message from Quds Force commander Qaani calling the interception of Gaza-bound flotillas an example of international terrorism.

threads.label: Khamenei messaging on workers and Persian Gulf
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published excerpts of a message marking Workers' Day and Teachers' Day urging support for domestic production and discouraging layoffs. A separate post marked National Persian Gulf Day on 10 Ordibehesht 1405, alongside an IRIB item describing the Persian Gulf as the lifeblood of Iran's coastal communities.

The Prime Minister and Foreign Minister of Qatar, in a telephone conversation, emphasised the full support of the government of that country for mediation efforts aimed at ending the crisis through peaceful means. The Foreign Minister of Qatar stressed that freedom of navigation is a fundamental and non-negotiable principle. Al Thani said that closing the Strait of Hormuz or using it as a bargaining tool would only deepen the crisis and endanger the vital interests of regional countries.

events.title_en: Spokesman of the Ministry of Industries: There is no problem in supplying raw materials to car manufacturers
events.summary_en: Spokesman of the Ministry of Industries: There is no problem in supplying raw materials to car manufacturers. There is no fundamental problem in supplying raw materials such as sheets and parts that require foreign currency. We have supplied the sheets needed by car manufacturers. Even Saipa has announced that it has supplied its required sheets and production is underway. Last week, 160 thousand tonnes of sheet were offered on the bourse. Claims of lack of sheet and production stoppage because of it are untrue. The recent increase in car prices is caused by a negative and baseless psychological atmosphere. The probable aim is inappropriate market-making and profiteering.

events.title_en: Emphasis by the Supreme Council of Cultural Revolution on the continuance of the 60 percent impact of the grade point average
events.summary_en: Emphasis by the Supreme Council of Cultural Revolution on the continuance of the 60 percent impact of the grade point average. Secretary of the Supreme Council of Cultural Revolution: The decision on the 60 percent impact of the grade point average for the eleventh and twelfth grades is the definitive view of the Supreme Council of Cultural Revolution. The efforts of some representatives to change this decision are an irresponsible act. The issue of grade point average impact should be examined taking into account different conditions from critical situations and war-like periods to normal educational conditions, so that the final decision is implemented without causing harm to students. Responsible bodies should be alert to these space-creations so that the implementation of the decision proceeds carefully and external pressures do not disrupt the decision-making process.

Lebanese sources reported intensified attacks by the Israeli regime's army on various areas of southern Lebanon. The Zionist regime's fighter jets, moments ago, bombed villages and towns of Kafra, Yater and Majdal Selm in southern Lebanon. The regime's artillery has also, using phosphorus shells, placed the Yahmar al-Shaqif area under fire. In the continuation of these attacks, Israeli drones attacked the town of Kafr Dunin and fighter jets bombed the area between Mifdoun and Zoutar al-Gharbiya three times. The town of Zoutar al-Sharqiya was also targeted by Israeli fighter jets.

events.title_en: Hacking and disclosure of 150,000 confidential emails of Robert Malley
events.summary_en: Hacking and disclosure of 150,000 confidential emails of Robert Malley. The Hanzalah hacking group announced that in a complex cyber operation, it succeeded in gaining complete access to the systems of Robert Malley, architect of anti-Iran sanctions and former adviser to the US President. According to this hacking group, 150,000 completely new and highly confidential emails belonging to Robert Malley, along with thousands of private conversations from his official account on X (formerly Twitter), have been made publicly available on the Hanzalah website for the first time. Hanzalah stressed that in these documents, there is irrefutable evidence of the direct role of the Zionist lobby in designing and implementing economic sanctions against Iran. Also Hanzalah

events.title: Iran cuts oil output as US blockade strains storage - BBG
events.summary: Iran has begun curbing oil production as the US naval blockade tightens around its oil trade, with exports plunging, storage filling and tankers gathering near the country’s main export hub, Bloomberg reported.

events.title: Iranian drones fuel Sudan war as conflict enters fourth year - Fox News
events.summary: Iran is facing accusations of supplying attack drones to Sudan’s army as the country’s civil war enters its fourth year, with US officials and analysts warning that drone strikes are increasingly hitting civilians, hospitals, schools and aid operations, Fox News reported.

events.title_en: The blessed tree; the fruit of 37 years of leadership of the martyred Leader
events.summary_en: The blessed tree; the fruit of 37 years of leadership of the martyred Leader. When our martyred Leader took on the leadership, the Islamic Republic system was like a sapling that had received numerous wounds from the enemies of Islam and Iran, and of course had borne them all well. But when, after nearly 37 years, they left the seat of the leadership of the nation, they left behind a blessed tree whose roots are strong and whose branches overshadow important parts of the region and the world. A passage from the message of Ayatollah Seyyed Mostafa Khamenei, Leader of the Islamic Revolution, 20 Farvardin 1405

events.title: ‘Permit for a terrorist’: Canada opposition asks who cleared ex-IRGC official’s entry
events.summary: The Canadian opposition has accused the government of bypassing its own rules after Iran International reported that an IRGC-linked Iranian football official was granted special permission to enter the country despite being inadmissible.

events.summary: Iran executed two more men on Saturday after the Supreme Court upheld their death sentences for spying for Israel and cooperating with the Mossad intelligence service.

events.title: Jailed Iranian Nobel laureate hospitalized after losing consciousness twice
events.summary: Iranian Nobel Peace Prize laureate Narges Mohammadi was urgently transferred from Zanjan Prison to a hospital on Friday after losing consciousness twice and suffering a severe deterioration in her health, her lawyer and the Narges Foundation said.
